title: console record page: one page at two widths — three resident columns (details | timeline | related) at 1280 px and up, two columns with a collapsible related rail from 1024 px, today's tabs below that and in the drawer
body:
Part of the record-page-v2 epic #26676 (child 2 of 4).

## Source (origin/main `416a76030e`)

The default record page is tabbed at every width: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts:950` `buildDefaultTabs` builds `Details`, then the related lists (one tab per child or one stacked `Related` tab by `relatedLayout`), then Approvals, Attachments, Activity (`showActivity`) and History (`history`); `DetailTabs.tsx` draws them through `page:tabs` in `RecordDetailView` (`:184-221`, URL-synced `?tab=`). The one width-aware piece is the opt-in `aside` region at `:1215-1262` (`showReferenceRail`, `hidden xl:flex`, holding `record:reference_rail`, which suppresses the Related tab when emitted) — viewport-based, not container-based. No `@container`, `ResizeObserver` or `matchMedia` branching exists in the synth or in `DetailTabs.tsx`. `RecordDetailView.tsx:3680` passes `embedded` into `RecordContextProvider` (react `RecordContext.tsx:196`); nothing in the synth reads it yet. On a 1440 px screen the details tab shows a wide form while the timeline, related lists and comments each sit behind a tab click; the drawer (resizable, 360 px floor) shows the same tabs, which is right there. The maintainer's ruling 1 says the drawer and the page are one page at two widths — the page's extra width should buy resident columns, not wider fields.

## Target

1. Container-width tiers on the synthesized default record page (not viewport: the same page in a drawer is narrow):
   - 1280 px and up: three resident columns — details (sections, empty fields folded as today) | timeline (activity + comments, the composer on top) | related lists (each as a card: title, count, the first rows, 「查看全部 N 条 →」, ＋) with the meta footer under them. The existing xl `aside` reference rail is the seed of this third column: fold it in (one rail, not two); keep `showReferenceRail` / `hideReferenceRail` meaning what they mean today and do not touch `packages/spec` in this card — if those are spec keys whose semantics would change, stop and report `needs_decision`.
   - 1024–1279 px: details | timeline, and related lists folded into a rail that opens from a 「关联 (N)」 toggle in the header row.
   - below 1024 px, and whenever the page is `embedded` (drawer / split pane; read it from `RecordContext`): the tabs exactly as today.
2. The record header (name, chips, actions, highlights, stage path) is shared by every tier — one component, no second header.
3. An authored record page (`page.kind: full`) is untouched; this is the synthesized default and `slotted` pages that use the default body. The `?tab=` URL state keeps working in the tabbed tier and is ignored in the column tiers.
4. No new metadata key: the tiers are the renderer's, measured by container query.

## File surface

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` (`buildDefaultTabs` and the page body it returns), `DetailTabs.tsx`, a new column-layout component beside them, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (passing `embedded` / the container down), tests beside, one changeset (`none` → patch, or `minor` if a plugin-detail export is added).

## Acceptance

1. Tests: at 1440 px container the default page renders three columns and no tab list; at 1100 px two columns and the related toggle; at 900 px and with `embedded` the tabs.
2. Screenshots in the PR body of a HotCRM lead at 1440, 1100 and in the drawer at its default width (the drawer and the page show the same header and the same sections).
3. The existing tab tests (`?tab=`, related-tab order, `hideRelatedTab`) still pass in the tabbed tier.

## Rulings (maintainer, 2026-10-27, chat in the filing session — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. The model, quoted back by the maintainer and ordered built: 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the drawer's top bar: 「左上角的 任务 · 2 / 2 · 分屏 几个字有必要嘛」 — no object name, no mode label on the bar.
3. On the position counter: 「我觉得记录详情页显示第几条记录 好像也没必要」 — no "n / N" anywhere on a record; the ↑ ↓ previous / next controls stay.
4. On the right pane: 「右侧应该可以拖动吗？展开为整页那个是不是用图标就可以」 — the pane is drag-resizable and "open as full page" is an icon-only control with a tooltip.
5. On related records, the maintainer confirmed the in-place model: 「所以关联记录是一层一层的往下点，然后可以一层一层的反悔吗」 — one level down per click, one level back per ← / Esc, never a second drawer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-27, from the record-page / list-page assessment and the clickable prototype the maintainer walked and ruled on in that session (objectstack main `416a76030e`, HotCRM `1f3f8880` on platform 18.2.0). The maintainer's instruction to build it, verbatim: 「你直接立卡派发处理这个开发，然后审核。」 Design evidence (never merged): branch `claude/record-page-v2-evidence-20261027b` at commit `345ec777220843ce1fd7f95b6cc0b2b6dcc81bf8`, folder `docs/design/record-page-v2-2026-10-27/` (`prototype.html`, `artboards/`, `assessment.md`).</sub>
